theme.styleGuide:
Volt Pitch is a builtin QoderWork AI Slides visual reference. Match its near-black institutional pitch-deck scheme, restrained electric-blue accents, and sharp, confident, institutional tone while using the bundled Alibaba PuHuiTi 3.0 font stack for generated slides.
Reference typography cues: display: Space Grotesk; heading: Space Grotesk; body: Inter; mono: IBM Plex Mono; serif_cn: Noto Serif SC; sans_cn: Noto Sans SC. Treat these font names as visual cues, not external font dependencies.
Color language: a near-black charcoal canvas (#0C0E12) with cool white type (#F5F7FA) and one disciplined electric-blue accent (#3B82F6, brightening to #60A5FA) reserved for the key numbers, growth marks, emphasis words, and hairline rules. Muted cool-gray (#9AA6B8) carries secondary copy. One coherent dark palette across every slide, no inverted theme.
Best for: Fundraising pitch decks, business plans, product launches for tech/SaaS/infrastructure startups; investor updates and board decks that should feel sharp, credible, and quietly ambitious.
Reference notes: An investor-grade dark pitch system in the modern tech-startup lineage (Stripe, Linear). Every slide is the same near-black charcoal field (#0C0E12) with a slightly lifted surface (#151A22) used only for panels, stat cards, and compare columns. Space Grotesk carries the display and headings — tight, geometric, quietly assertive at large sizes; huge market-size and metric numbers are the visual event of the deck. Inter handles body and lead copy in a clean supporting role, and IBM Plex Mono provides the kicker, page-number, and label voice that reads as instrument-panel chrome. The electric blue is used with severe restraint: key statistics, the growing bar in a chart, one emphasized word inside a headline, the 28px accent rule, and list markers — never as a fill for large areas. Depth is flat and precise: 1px hairline borders at low foreground opacity, no drop shadows on type, generous negative space, and a persistent bottom-left company/round chrome plus a top page counter on every slide. The mood is a term sheet rendered as a keynote — cold, exact, ambitious, and completely composed.

decorativePatterns.name: visual-system
decorativePatterns.description:
Near-black charcoal canvas with electric-blue accents and cool white type. Sharp, confident, institutional-grade pitch energy.
Volt Pitch is a near-black institutional pitch-deck system: a single #0C0E12 charcoal field on every slide, cool white #F5F7FA type, muted #9AA6B8 secondary copy, and one disciplined electric-blue accent (#3B82F6 / #60A5FA).
Space Grotesk is the structural display and heading face — geometric, tight, assertive at large sizes; huge market-size and metric numbers are the deck's visual event. Inter carries body copy; IBM Plex Mono carries kickers, labels, and page-number chrome. Bilingual EN/CN support via Noto Serif SC / Noto Sans SC fallbacks.
The color philosophy is one dark field, one accent, used with severe restraint. The field is #0C0E12; panels and stat cards lift to #151A22 (surface) with #1E2836 secondary blocks. Electric blue appears only on key numbers, the growing bar in a chart, one emphasized headline word, the thin accent rule, and list markers — never as a large fill. Borders are 1px hairlines from the border token (#232B36) or low-opacity white; there are no drop shadows on type and no gradients on the field.
Depth is flat and precise. Every slide keeps a persistent bottom-left company/round annotation and a top-right page counter, reading as instrument-panel chrome. The compare layout is the one place two lifted surface shades sit side by side to split legacy vs. Volt. The mood is a term sheet rendered as a keynote — cold, exact, ambitious, completely composed.
**Key Characteristics:** - Single near-black charcoal field (#0C0E12) on every slide; electric blue reserved for the numbers and growth story only
